name: Phi-4-mm-inst-zeroth-kor
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Korean ASR + ko<->en speech-translation fine-tune of microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct (5.57B, same tensor set, same config: 32 layers, hidden 3072, 8 KV heads x 128, 131,072 context). Trained 1 epoch / 174 steps on kresnik/zeroth_korean only, audio encoder unfrozen; a deliberately small PoC testing whether Korean ASR training transfers to translation. CAVEAT that dominates the headline row: the base 'original' column scores 195.92 CER on Korean, i.e. Phi-4-mm does not do Korean ASR at all, so 7.02 vs 195.92 is new-language coverage rather than a like-for-like delta - the same caveat the catalog already records for phi-4-multimodal-finetune-ko-speech. The AST columns are the fairer comparison and the margins there are modest (+1.45 ko2en BLEU). Evaluated on a single A40 with the author's own script. NOT a duplicate: the existing phi-4-multimodal-finetune-ko-speech (daekeun-ml) is a different repo, different training data (4 corpora, 4 epochs) and a better model, whose card flags regression against this one on ko2en-cot. No licence tag on the repo; repo created 2025-02-27.

CAVEAT: the base scores ~195 CER on Korean, i.e. it does not do Korean ASR at all, so most of the gap is new-language coverage rather than a capability delta between two working systems.
